reason: Full-source review finds the candidate otherwise accurate, complete, and carefully bounded. It correctly separates the primary Anrok-calculation path from Stripe's native Stripe Tax engine, preserves the distinct coexistence mode in which Stripe Tax calculates while Anrok picks up Stripe transaction data for compliance, filing, and reporting, does not infer dual calculation or transaction-sync guarantees, and retains the unresolved Product-versus-ContractProduct terminology split. It also accurately covers customer address and Taxable prerequisites, Anrok's provider-specific default-classification fallback, inline arrears calculation, finalized-invoice verification through automatic_tax.provider = anrok, and the unknown liability.type semantics. The canonical URL and nested raw_files value match the trusted order, the path-qualified raw backlink resolves, the source target is absent, all related links resolve, the raw SHA-256 matches, candidate.md equals receipt.source_page, suggestions.json equals receipt.suggestions, and all five quotes are byte-exact at their cited locations. Two bounded semantic issues prevent approval. First, the raw page instructs threshold flows to set tax_type: STRIPE but never defines that enum's semantics; the candidate and the Metronome-integrations durable-fact suggestion go beyond the source by saying the literal identifies the Stripe invoice path. The supported boundary is only that STRIPE is the documented value in this Anrok-through-Stripe threshold configuration and cannot identify the calculator, because the same flow selects Anrok as provider. Second, the source contributes concrete provider-specific invoice behavior that is absent from metronome-invoicing: Anrok calculates arrears tax inline without requiring invoices to remain drafts, threshold billing uses the documented STRIPE and INVOICE configuration values, and verification occurs on the finalized Stripe invoice. Under the concept-audit and reciprocal-citation rules, this requires a bounded invoicing durable-fact suggestion and matching source link. The other three submitted concept suggestions are grounded, correctly anchored, and non-conflicting; no company, index, log, comparison, new-concept, or contradiction-callout update is needed.
